response.sql: WITH circuit_averages AS (SELECT r.circuitId, c.country, AVG(r."round") AS average_round FROM races AS r JOIN circuits AS c ON c.circuitId = r.circuitId GROUP BY r.circuitId, c.country), comparisons AS (SELECT circuitId, country, average_round, average_round - AVG(average_round) OVER (PARTITION BY country) AS difference_from_country FROM circuit_averages) SELECT circuitId, country, average_round, difference_from_country FROM comparisons ORDER BY difference_from_country IS NULL, difference_from_country DESC LIMIT 10
